description: Hello fellow devs! We are Space Bokeronas, 2 tech girls based in Málaga : SARA(full stack developer)  and LAVINIA(cross-platform developer) with a strong interest in  software engineering and geospatial analysis.
summary: Earth Jukebox is  that makes NASA’s Earth Information Center visualizations accessible through sound as well as sight. We transformed NASA Earth data and imagery into sound and our work starts with making these resources discoverable and trustworthy. The current web application is built with React, TypeScript and Vite, offers a searchable, filterable catalog of official NASA videos, streamed on demand and linked to their original sources with full credits. A custom Node.js pipeline imports curated NASA sources over validated HTTPS connections and keeps the last valid catalog if any source fails. Automated tests and production builds verify the codebase. The sonification maps frames from these visualizations to audio, so users can hear evolutional changes in the planet, such as sea surface temperature anomalies . This opens Earth science to people who cannot easily read charts and to anyone who understands data best through sound.

Earth Information Jukebox

Team Space Bokeronas :

#NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 – Málaga, Spain

Earth Information Jukebox is an interactive web application that explores a new way of experiencing our planet by transforming Earth science information into sound.

Inspired by NASA's Earth Information Center, our project aims to make complex environmental information more engaging, accessible and understandable through the combination of visual storytelling and audio sonification.

How does it work?

The application combines an interactive visual interface with sound generation.

Users can explore Earth-related information through visual elements and experience how evolution makes changes in environmental variables can be represented through different audio characteristics.

The sonification approach connects data values with musical parameters such as pitch, rhythm and intensity, creating an alternative way to interpret scientific information.

The prototype integrates interactive controls, audio playback, visual feedback and an Earth-inspired interface to encourage exploration and discovery.

Benefits and intended impact

Earth Information Jukebox aims to:

  • Make Earth science more engaging through multisensory interaction.
  • Offer an alternative way to explore environmental information beyond traditional charts and maps.
  • Encourage curiosity about our planet and its changing systems.
  • Support inclusive science communication by exploring sound as an additional channel for understanding information.
  • Inspire new ways of combining science, technology and creativity.

Our long-term vision is to help people connect with Earth science not only through what they see, but also through what they hear.

Technology and development :

The project was developed as a web-based prototype using HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript,React,Vite,WebAudio API,Node.js,FFmpeg, Node Test Runner for automatic testing and also Git and Github,all together with browser-based audio technologies and interactive visual components. These technologies allow the application to generate sound, respond to user interaction and present information through a unified experience.

Creativity and innovation:

The creative aspect of Earth Information Jukebox lies in treating Earth science as an audiovisual experience. Instead of simply displaying environmental information, we explore how scientific variables can become sound, allowing users to experience data in a different and memorable way.

Space Bokeronas Team considerations:

During development, we considered usability, accessibility, visual clarity, the relationship between scientific information and sound, and the importance of making the experience intuitive for different audiences. We also considered the need to distinguish scientific data from illustrative or demonstration content, ensuring that the experience does not misrepresent the information being presented.

Our mission

We believe that understanding our planet should be an experience available to everyone. With Earth Information Jukebox, Space Bokeronas wants to give Earth science a new voice.

Science is not only something we see. It is something we can hear.
